    Families of stable bricks from projective presentations #

    structure EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.IsStableImageWitness (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    Prop

    The stable-brick witnesses tracked for each presentation.

    • brick : IsBrick M
    • stable : ((eulerWeight k P).corrected (dimensionWeight k) M).IsStable M
    • quotient : ∃ (q : P.target ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.Epi q ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp P.differential q = 0
    • toNakayamaKernel : ∃ (f : M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P), f ≠ 0

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.card_le_mul_number_stable_image_witnesses (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] {P₁ P₀ : FGModuleCat R} [Module.Projective R ↑P₁] [Module.Projective R ↑P₀] [Fintype k] (B : (P₁ ⟶ P₀) → FGModuleCat R) (hB : ∀ (p : P₁ ⟶ P₀), IsStableImageWitness k (ofDifferential p) (B p)) :
      Fintype.card k ≤ Nat.card ↑(Set.range (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B)) * (Module.finrank k ↑P₁.obj * Module.finrank k ↑P₀.obj)

      Over a finite field, the number of isomorphism classes in a family of presentation witnesses is at least the field size divided by the uniform degree bound.
